data: Which of the following parameters are being varied to study the trade-off between G-BLEU and Style accuracy in Yelp?

2. The second subfigure shows the trade-off curve of G-BLEU and Style accuracy according to β (at α = 0.7).

From this, we can infer that the parameters being varied are α and β. These are the variables that are being manipulated to observe the trade-off between G-BLEU and Style accuracy.
